subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's custom yielding glob walker and yielded bootstrap hook dispatch as the compatibility tradeoff for fixing the bootstrap-context event-loop stall after the lint blocker is repaired?
rationale: The remaining code defect is mechanical, but green CI will not fully settle upgrade behavior for glob parity and hook scheduling on a session-context hot path.

options.title: Accept After Lint And Green CI
options.body: Repair the two lint errors, let exact-head CI pass, and land while owning the scoped glob-walker and hook-interleaving behavior change.

options.title: Require Connected Runtime Proof
options.body: Ask for a live embedded_run or Crabbox trace showing keepalives or timers remain responsive through bootstrap-context before merge.

options.title: Split The Patch
options.body: Pause or split if maintainers want async file reads separated from custom glob walking and hook scheduling.

recommendation.title: Accept After Lint And Green CI
recommendation.body: Repair the two lint errors, let exact-head CI pass, and land while owning the scoped glob-walker and hook-interleaving behavior change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across bootstrap helpers, hook contracts, and SDK-boundary compatibility decisions touched here.
